setup: Line your knee up with the machine's pivot
Pad on the front of the ankle
Back against the seat, hold the handles
Pick a lighter pin than for both legs
execution: Squeeze the thigh for a moment at the top
Lower slowly until the weights nearly touch
faults: Don't lift your hips off the seat
Don't drop the stack between reps

notes: Set the seat so the knee lines up with the machine's pivot; a misaligned knee makes the pad slide and the movement awkward.
Start with your weaker side and match the reps on the other side.
The stack number is the selector reading, not the true resistance, and it isn't half of a two-leg set.
If pain lingers or comes back, stop this exercise and get it checked by a physio or doctor.
stopIf: Pain at the front of the knee that builds during the set
Pain that changes how you move

keyPositions.label: Start
keyPositions.describe: Seated, back on the pad, hands on the handles. Near knee bent to about 90°, ankle pad on the lower shin. Far leg relaxed.

keyPositions.label: Top
keyPositions.describe: Near leg straight, thigh still on the seat, hips down. Far leg unchanged.

ikHints: Ankle pad stays on the near shin
